_comment: The FluxPlugs commit whose plugin-tools build every plugin here, and the repository it lives in. During the private beta that is the maintainer's repository, which the workflows check out with the FLUXPLUGS_TOKEN secret (a fine-grained token with read access to its contents); FLUXPLUGS_DISPATCH_TOKEN needs write access to it so the store rebuilds. When the code moves to FluxerDevs/FluxPlugs, point repository there and the secrets can go.
